msg: Writing a English launch script from 42 sourced facts
Combining the brand's look with local conventions
Inter for all text. Headline: 100px, weight 800, tracking -0.02em. Supporting text: 36px, weight 500. Mono: 18px, weight 400.

brief.palette: Background #f5efe3, Surface #fffcf5, Text #1c1a17, Muted #655e53, Primary #c5361d, Accent #1e3b63
brief.typography: Inter for all text. Headline: 100px, weight 800, tracking -0.02em. Supporting text: 36px, weight 500. Mono: 18px, weight 400.
brief.motion: 250ms to 350ms duration. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Quick cuts between scenes, no lingering transitions.
brief.layout: 1920x1080 canvas. Center-aligned vertical stack. 120px padding on all sides. Scene 1: Headline only. Scene 2: Headline + 2 supporting points. Scene 3: Single proof metric or logo strip. Scene 4: Logo, CTA button, URL.
notes: Use #c5361d (Primary) for the main headline and CTA button to signal boldness and positivity, avoiding its use for error states.
Limit each scene to one bold headline and at most two short supporting points to maintain high whitespace and sparse layout.
Start Scene 1 with a pain-point statement rather than product features to align with SaaS launch best practices.
Display proof in Scene 3 as a single large number or a single quote, not a list of multiple data points.
Ensure all text uses the Inter font family, overriding the brand's Iowan Old Style for headings to match market style rules.
End the video on Scene 4 with the LaunchLocally logo, a single call-to-action button, and the URL, ensuring no other elements are present.
